beats.say: Hello! Cameras are handy at home and at work. But if the password was never changed, a stranger can watch too.
Most new cameras ship with a default password. Lists of these passwords are open to anyone online.
In 2025, unauthorised access to home and office cameras was found in Azerbaijan, with footage uploaded to foreign sites.

visual.label: Unauthorised access to home and office cameras found

beats.say: Three steps are enough: change the password, update the firmware, and close open access from the internet.

scenes.prompt: Create a new password for the camera panel.
tips: Do not type your real password here, this is practice.
Pick a phrase of four random words.
Do not reuse your Wi-Fi or email password.
Keep the password in a password manager.

scenes.title: Setting up the camera
scenes.intro: You are setting up a new camera. Look at every window in the panel and choose the right button.

steps.say: You are signing in to the camera panel for the first time.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: Correct, this is the camera's own address on your home network. Change the password right after the first sign-in.

actions.label: Close tab
actions.feedback: Without signing in, you cannot change the default password. The camera stays open to everyone.

body.text: Change the password now for your security.

actions.label: Change password
actions.feedback: Well done. Changing the default password is the single most important step for a camera.

actions.label: Remind me later
actions.feedback: Getting in with a default password takes no skill at all. Automated tools search for such cameras all the time.

body.text: Security holes have been fixed. The update takes about three minutes.

actions.label: Update
actions.feedback: Correct. Attackers know the holes in old firmware very well.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Without the update, known holes stay open. Update it today.

body.text: Turn on UPnP and port forwarding to watch the camera directly from the internet?

steps.say: Now the camera offers direct access from the internet.

actions.label: Keep on
actions.feedback: With an open port, the camera is visible to the whole internet. Attackers find such open devices easily with special search tools.

actions.label: Turn off
actions.feedback: Right. If you need to watch remotely, use the maker's official app instead of opening a port.

steps.label: Create a public link for the live stream? Anyone with the link will be able to watch.

actions.label: Create link
actions.feedback: Once the link spreads, you will never know who is watching. Add family members in the app with their own accounts.

actions.label: Do not create a public link
actions.feedback: Correct. Only people close to you, signed in with their own accounts, should see the picture.

scenes.prompt: Find the risky settings in the video recorder's status window.

body.text: Camera 3: HR room, facing computer screens

spots.label: Default password
spots.explain: Attackers take default passwords from ready-made lists. Changing it is the first job.

spots.label: Old firmware
spots.explain: A device left without updates for seven years has known holes. If no updates come out, the device must be replaced.

spots.label: Open port
spots.explain: An open port shows the recorder to the whole internet. If it is not needed, close it.

spots.label: Camera facing screens
spots.explain: This camera films work screens and documents. If the footage is stolen, confidential data goes with it.

question.prompt: A colleague brought a Wi-Fi camera from home and wants to connect it at work. What do you say?

options.label: Technical support must approve it and connect it
options.feedback: Correct. Only approved devices go on the work network.

options.label: Fine, if they change the password
options.feedback: The password matters, but an unchecked device can open a door into the work network. Technical support decides.

options.label: Put it on guest Wi-Fi, nobody will know
options.feedback: A device connected without telling anyone is a risk for the office. Every camera goes through technical support.

scenes.explain: At work, only technical support connects cameras and smart devices. A forgotten device stays without updates for years.

points: Change the default password on day one.
Update the firmware, close open ports.
